operation.native: identity-bound regular-file hard-link publication relative to a held destination directory
operation.safety: no replacement, source revalidation, destination identity verification, destination-directory flush
operation.ui: strict native-name dialog, selected regular-file requirement, modal command scope, acknowledged refresh
operation.scope_boundary: same-pane destination only; cross-pane hard-link workflow remains open

windows_x64.runtime_abi: /MT matched to the installed ckVision static SDK

safety: The source is reopened and its full identity is compared with the stamped identity before link creation.
Destination names are created without replacement and duplicate names are reported as Changed.
The published destination identity is verified before the destination directory flush is attempted.
Temporary/build/fixture paths obey the Mac, Linux, and Windows workstation drive policies.
No production app instance was launched or left running.
